evals.prompt: Extend Load with comment support and structured line errors as described in README. Implement, test, and document the behavior. Keep the library small.
evals.expected_output: Caller input causes and valid prefix survive; successful errors are nil.
assertions: Comment physical line numbering and *LineError fields are correct.
A reader returning bytes plus a custom error retains parsed bytes and exposes the cause; EOF is completion.
Long valid records are not silently bounded by Scanner defaults.

evals.prompt: Add blank-key rejection and useful context to account lookup failures as described in README. Implement and test it without expanding the API beyond the needed classification.
evals.expected_output: Error context respects domain identity and diagnostic exposure.
assertions: ErrInvalidKey rejects blank keys without a backend call.
Unavailable errors classify through errors.Is without exposing backend error identity/type/text.

evals.prompt: Make writer finalization failures visible and implement ExportLimit plus the optional positional CLI limit described in README. Add tests and usage docs.
evals.expected_output: Owned finalization is truthful and does not overwrite or hide primary failures.
assertions: Exactly one close on all paths, accepted-prefix count preserved.
Single errors retain direct identity; concurrent primary and close failures expose both causes.
CLI exit/stdout/stderr and positional filename behavior are correct.

evals.prompt: Fix pages so exact multiples and zero items do not overcount. Keep the helper private and add regression tests.
evals.expected_output: Local calculation fix without error-contract selection.
assertions: No exported API, new errors, or unrelated changes.

evals.prompt: Add WriteSelected for caller-defined row filtering, with the behavior in README. Implement, test, and document it while keeping WriteRows compatible.
evals.expected_output: Filtering preserves completion error inspection across buffered CSV encoding.
assertions: Selected rows retain valid CSV/order and nil keep selects all.
Final buffered write failure is returned and inspectable; borrowed writer is not closed.
No per-row durability claim or retry is invented.

evals.prompt: Add CollectMatching to filter cursor rows while retaining Collect, according to README. Implement, test, and document it. Keep the implementation small.
evals.expected_output: Filtered iteration preserves valid prefix and reports incomplete iteration.
assertions: Iteration Err is inspected after Next returns false; no false success.
Scan failure retains its cause and selected prefix.
Owned cursor closes once; nil predicate and order work.
